moments.cue: On September 11, 1985, the plane released the cargo; weeks later, a bear in the same area was found dead.
Investigators found the bear’s stomach literally packed with roughly seventy‑five pounds of the drug.
The chief medical examiner described the bear’s stomach as completely full of the powder.
The bear was taxidermied and now sits behind glass in a Lexington shopping mall.
